::: {#exr-clipped}

#### Clipping the gradient

`train(net, max_norm=1)` applies [gradient clipping](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#def-gradient-clipping):
before each step,
`nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_` rescales any [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) with [norm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-inner-products.html#def-norm) above 1 to norm 1 [@pytorch_clip_grad_norm].
Trained this way for 20 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch),
does the pixel reader classify more test digits correctly than in @sol-pixels?

:::
